query: user-centric agents co-evolve environment and user simulator
meta-agent modifies training environment during multi-turn reinforcement learning
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The closest match. A meta-agent modifies the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during ongoing multi-turn training.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute).  
   **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523

2. **From Trainee to Trainer: LLM-Designed Training Environment for RL with Multi-Agent Reasoning** — Closely related: the current policy analyzes failures and redesigns the next stage’s RL environment, though changes occur between stages rather than live within a training run.  
   **People:** Chao Chen and Zhiwei Li (LARK, HKUST Guangzhou); Chengzu Li and Yinhong Liu (University of Cambridge); Zhijiang Guo (LARK, HKUST Guangzhou/HKUST).  
   **URL:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17682

query: adaptive user simulator reward design LLM agents
text:
1. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — Directly studies how turn-level reward shaping, trajectory scoring, and simulator choice affect multi-turn LLM-agent training.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian, Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Heng Ji, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Huan Wang.  
   **Affiliations:** Salesforce AI Research; University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736)

2. **Training Proactive and Personalized LLM Agents** — Introduces UserVille and a multi-objective reward combining task success, interaction effort, and preference adherence.  
   **People:** Weiwei Sun, Xuhui Zhou, Weihua Du, Xingyao Wang, Sean Welleck, Graham Neubig, Maarten Sap, Yiming Yang.  
   **Affiliations:** Carnegie Mellon University; OpenHands.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02208](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02208)

3. **UserLM-R1: Modeling Human Reasoning in User Language Models with Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning** — Builds adaptive profiles and goal-driven simulated users, then improves their strategic behavior using composite RL rewards.  
   **People:** Feng Zhang, Shijia Li, Chunmao Zhang, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Jingwen Xu, Han Liu.  
   **Affiliations:** Meituan; Peking University; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Dalian University of Technology.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09215](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09215)

4. **Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards** — Proposes Turing-RL: an LLM judge rewards simulated responses according to how indistinguishable they are from a real user’s responses, rather than simple response matching.  
   **People:** Yingshan Susan Wang, Cedegao E. Zhang, Linlu Qiu, Zexue He, Pengyuan Li, Alex Pentland, Roger P. Levy, Yoon Kim.  
   **Affiliations:** MIT; Stanford University; MIT–IBM Watson AI Lab.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19336](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19336)

5. **LLM-Powered User Simulator for Recommender System** — Uses an interpretable combination of LLM-derived preference logic and statistical modeling to supply simulated engagement for RL recommender agents.  
   **People:** Zijian Zhang, Shuchang Liu, Ziru Liu, Rui Zhong, Qingpeng Cai, Xiangyu Zhao, Chunxu Zhang, Qidong Liu, Peng Jiang.  
   **Affiliations:** Jilin University; Kuaishou Technology; City University of Hong Kong; Xi’an Jiaotong University.  
   **URL:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.16984](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.16984)
